project.name: prx
project.tagline: the agent-run PR contract / work-unit CLI
project.description: The agent-run work-unit CLI: capability-scoped agents driving each work unit through one signed, content-addressed pipeline to a merged PR — git-writes signed and verified against their owner.
claims: An agent cannot perform an action its role doesn't own.
A privileged effect not produced by its owning actor fails verification.
A beads work unit can travel intake → merged PR through one signed pipeline.
A derivation's identity is content-addressed: any change to its manifest changes its id.
